items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer introduces Hal Vernon as a pianist aware of the Bebop movement, but the interviewee (Teddy Edwards) does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory, or statement indicating a direct personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: And also a very fine alto player, Leroy Robertson. They called him Sweetpea. He worked with Roy Porter's band. But he had a very warm feeling and a beautiful sound on his instrument, you know.
